strategy_scope: New contacts use acquisition tracks. Internal marketing calendar and event cadence apply only to their own campaign types.

schedule.cadence_status: test settings; adjust from measured results

flows.condition: Identity, route, role, sender, offer and dynamic facts verified; alternatives inactive
flows.action: Send the row's campaign_message_v3
flows.example_copy: Use the personalised row; include a recipient hook only when hook_status is Verified
flows.principle: Offer-led, recipient-centred, one CTA; PE023 and PE024

flows.condition: No reply, referral, refusal, opt-out, bounce, OOO or active duplicate
flows.action: Send campaign_follow_up_1_v3 in the same thread
flows.example_copy: Add durable value pillars and the campus-fit check; offer the one-page outline
flows.principle: Add useful context; do not repeat the opening

flows.condition: All stop checks still pass
flows.action: Send campaign_follow_up_2_v3 and end the sequence
flows.example_copy: Ask whether to send the outline or close the conversation
flows.principle: Lower-effort final ask; stop after three delivered messages

flows.condition: Match provider event to account and message; deduplicate
flows.action: Cancel all pending cold follow-ups for the account and classify the reply
flows.example_copy: No generic automatic pitch
flows.principle: Response handling overrides the cold sequence

flows.condition: A current owner can confirm audience and format
flows.action: Draft a short planning response and offer real availability
flows.delay: Same working period or next working day
flows.example_copy: Thank you. Could we confirm the audience and the easiest format for one optional session?
flows.principle: Make the next step concrete

flows.condition: Approved information is available
flows.action: Send the concise outline or approved fact sheet
flows.example_copy: The outline covers the English-medium programme, digital learning, available levels and how families arrange a visit.
flows.principle: Answer the request with approved facts only

flows.condition: Referral and contact route verified
flows.action: Transfer the same account to the referred colleague; keep prior sequence cancelled
flows.example_copy: Thank you for pointing me to [colleague]. I will address the outline to them.
flows.principle: One active sequence per organisation

flows.condition: Recipient gives a future date or period
flows.action: Record the requested timing and draft one contextual follow-up for that date
flows.example_copy: Thank you. I will follow up in [requested period].
flows.principle: Respect stated timing

flows.trigger: Refusal, opt-out, hard bounce or out of office
flows.condition: Event type verified
flows.action: Suppress on refusal/opt-out/bounce; pause to stated return date for OOO
flows.database_update: suppressed, channel_invalid or paused; pending steps cancelled
flows.example_copy: No further sales message; a simple acknowledgement may be used for a human refusal
flows.principle: Stop before scheduling another touch

flows.condition: Current operation, committee route and locality verified; 2027 facts approved
flows.action: Send the row's SACCOS campaign_message_v3
flows.example_copy: Offer an optional member information session without a loan, subsidy or discount claim
flows.principle: Qualification before enrichment; PE015 and PE024

flows.condition: F01 stop checks pass
flows.action: Send the SACCOS first follow-up in the same thread
flows.example_copy: Offer the one-page version using approved fee information without figures unless cleared
flows.principle: Add practical value

flows.condition: F01 stop checks pass
flows.action: Send the final low-effort ask and stop
flows.example_copy: Should I send the member-information outline for a quick review, or close this for now?
flows.principle: Limited pursuit

flows.condition: Audience, owner, date, time, venue, capacity, content and RSVP route confirmed
flows.action: Open the event brief and asset workflow
flows.delay: At least 21 calendar days before the session
flows.example_copy: No audience message yet
flows.principle: SOP preparation gate; PE012

flows.condition: Written approval exists at least 48 hours before scheduled delivery
flows.action: Give the approved invitation to the partner for circulation
flows.delay: Default 14 calendar days before the session, or approved date
flows.example_copy: Silverleaf Academy will hold an optional admissions Q&A for [Partner] staff on [confirmed date/time].
flows.principle: Concrete opt-in route; PE013 and PE017

flows.condition: Parent supplies their own contact and preference
flows.action: Assign admissions owner and acknowledge
flows.delay: Same working period where possible; no later than next working day
flows.example_copy: Which age or grade are you enquiring about, and which area would you travel from?
flows.principle: Qualify before recommending

flows.trigger: Age or grade and area received
flows.condition: Admissions confirms campus fit, availability and current information
flows.action: Offer real visit slots or the correct application step
flows.example_copy: Based on what you shared, we can discuss [confirmed campus]. Would you like to arrange a visit?
flows.principle: Specific relevant next step

flows.condition: Actual event recorded by admissions
flows.action: Update the funnel and report aggregate partner results
flows.example_copy: No automatic sales message required
flows.principle: Track Inquiry -> Tour -> Application -> Enrollment; PE021

flows.condition: Original author, date, request, source language, current relevance and allowed reply route verified
flows.action: Prepare one contextual requalification reply
flows.example_copy: I saw your [date] enquiry about [specific need] in [area]. Are you still looking?
flows.principle: Use the actual need; no inferred parenthood

flows.condition: Original public route still permits a relevant response
flows.action: Post or send the one reviewed reply
flows.example_copy: If it would help, reply with the student's age or grade and the area you would travel from.
flows.principle: One answerable question

flows.trigger: No reply or enquiry is unrelated
flows.condition: No current interest or outside school scope
flows.action: Close or hold with the precise reason
flows.example_copy: No further outreach
flows.principle: Historical interest is not current intent

flows.trigger: Fresh inbound enquiry or explicit opt-in
flows.condition: Valid channel, consent or inbound context, source and owner recorded
flows.action: Acknowledge and ask for age or grade plus travel area
flows.delay: Same working period where possible; no later than next working day
flows.example_copy: Tafadhali jibu kwa umri au darasa la mwanafunzi na eneo unalosafiri kutoka.
flows.principle: Low-friction qualification; PE003, PE004 and PE011

flows.condition: No reply, application, visit, refusal or opt-out
flows.action: Send one helpful reminder explaining why the two details matter
flows.example_copy: Age or grade and travel area help us check the right campus and current information.
flows.principle: Add context, not pressure

flows.condition: All stop checks pass
flows.action: Send a close-the-loop message and stop
flows.example_copy: If you would still like information, reply with the student's age or grade and travel area. Otherwise, we will close this enquiry for now.
flows.principle: Clear ending; proposed service-level test

flows.condition: Reply matched to enquiry
flows.action: Cancel pending reminders and enter F04 fit check
flows.example_copy: No generic response; answer the stated question
flows.principle: Response overrides nurture

flows.condition: Campus, date, time, venue, capacity, registration route, owners and content confirmed
flows.action: Create event brief and assets
flows.example_copy: No direct message yet
flows.principle: Internal preparation precedes external invitation; PE012

flows.condition: Recipient is opted in or otherwise appropriate and campus fit is plausible
flows.action: Send one invitation with one RSVP action
flows.example_copy: Silverleaf Academy will hold an open day at [confirmed campus] on [date/time]. Reply [RSVP] if you would like to join.
flows.principle: One invitation for non-responders; PE017

flows.condition: Registration exists and event remains confirmed
flows.action: Send logistics, location and what to bring
flows.example_copy: Here are the confirmed time, location pin and joining instructions for your visit.
flows.principle: Reminder only after RSVP

flows.condition: No cancellation and no opt-out
flows.action: Send final concise reminder
flows.example_copy: We look forward to welcoming you tomorrow at [confirmed time and campus].
flows.principle: Practical reminder, no repeated pitch

flows.condition: Attendance and parent identity matched
flows.action: Thank the attendee and offer the next admissions step
flows.example_copy: Thank you for visiting. Would you like us to check the next admissions step for [age/grade]?
flows.principle: Move an actual attendee to the funnel

flows.condition: Event details, audience and goal confirmed
flows.action: Publish the platform-appropriate announcement and begin production
flows.example_copy: Approved event announcement with date, time, venue and one CTA
flows.principle: SOP public cadence; PE012 and PE013

flows.condition: Approved teaser asset available
flows.action: Publish teaser or behind-the-scenes content
flows.example_copy: 15-30 second Reel or event preparation post
flows.principle: Build interest with new information

flows.condition: Approved countdown and logistics are current
flows.action: Publish seven-day countdown and community logistics
flows.example_copy: What to expect, when and where
flows.principle: Useful event detail

flows.condition: Approved story or feature asset available
flows.action: Publish preview, speaker or student story; public social only
flows.example_copy: One specific event highlight
flows.principle: Reserve distinct material for follow-up

flows.condition: All platforms and live coverage logistics ready
flows.action: Publish final public reminder
flows.example_copy: See you tomorrow at [confirmed details]
flows.principle: Last factual reminder

flows.condition: Approved shot list, media permissions and platform owner active
flows.action: Publish only the platform-specific live coverage allowed by the SOP
flows.example_copy: WhatsApp maximum two event updates; social cadence follows the SOP
flows.principle: Safeguarding and over-notification controls; PE018 and PE019

flows.condition: Approved photos and copy available
flows.action: Publish thank-you Stories, photo carousel/album and WhatsApp thank-you
flows.delay: Within 2 hours for Stories; within 24 hours for photos and WhatsApp
flows.example_copy: Thank the community and show approved highlights
flows.principle: SOP post-event clock; PE014

flows.condition: Brand end screen, subtitles, permissions and copy approved
flows.action: Publish Reel and full highlight video
flows.delay: Within 48 hours for Reel; within 72 hours for YouTube video
flows.example_copy: One approved highlight story and next action
flows.principle: Accessible, on-brand video; PE014

flows.condition: Platform, registration, attendance and admissions events available
flows.action: Complete report and debrief
flows.example_copy: No audience send required
flows.principle: Campaign N+1 should reuse the learning

flows.condition: 2027 facts, route, owner and collateral confirmed
flows.action: Send one admissions announcement to the eligible opt-in audience
flows.example_copy: Applications for 2027 are open. Reply with student age or grade and travel area.
flows.principle: Planned internal schedule; no fee figures; PE001, PE015 and PE016

flows.condition: No response, application, enrolment, refusal or opt-out; campaign remains current
flows.action: Send a campus-fit and visit-oriented broadcast
flows.example_copy: Tell us the student's age or grade and travel area so we can check the right campus and current information.
flows.principle: Primary intake season; PE003 and PE004

flows.condition: Suppression checks pass and a real admissions next step is available
flows.action: Offer practical application help or a confirmed visit
flows.example_copy: Would you like current admissions steps or help arranging a campus visit?
flows.principle: Remove false urgency; one useful next step

flows.condition: Office coverage and response owner confirmed; suppression checks pass
flows.action: Send a final new-year check-in and end the planned series
flows.example_copy: If 2027 is still under consideration, reply with student age or grade and travel area.
flows.principle: Close the loop without a fabricated deadline

flows.condition: Current family roster, consent basis, grade, campus and transition date verified
flows.action: Explain the upcoming transition and available confirmed pathways
flows.delay: Proposed 12 weeks before the relevant primary intake window
flows.example_copy: We would like to help you plan the next school stage. May we share the confirmed primary options?
flows.principle: Warm lifecycle journey; PE022

flows.condition: Family remains eligible and no opt-out
flows.action: Share a confirmed primary-campus guide
flows.example_copy: Here are the confirmed campus options and admissions steps for the next stage.
flows.principle: Answer likely questions before asking for a visit

flows.condition: Real visit slots available
flows.action: Offer a campus visit
flows.example_copy: Would you like to visit [confirmed campus] on one of these available dates?
flows.principle: Concrete decision support

flows.condition: Human owner has reviewed the record
flows.action: Make one final planning check-in and stop automation
flows.example_copy: Would a short planning call help, or should we close this transition conversation for now?
flows.principle: Human review for a high-value warm family

flows.condition: Referral scheme approval, terms, eligibility, consent and tracking are absent
flows.action: Do not send or schedule referral copy
flows.example_copy: No reward or referral promise may be drafted as active
flows.principle: The Gantt chart schedules referral-scheme approval through 2026-10-30; PE015

flows.trigger: A new organisation or business-contact source row is imported
flows.condition: Source attribution and a stable source record exist
flows.action: Normalise organisation, person and contact-route fields
flows.example_copy: No outreach copy yet
flows.principle: Append-only provenance and exact-match deduplication

flows.condition: Exact domain, public email, profile URL or verified name-and-organisation match has been evaluated
flows.action: Reuse the canonical entity or create a review item for ambiguity
flows.example_copy: Do not merge similar names without evidence
flows.principle: Preserve conflicting assertions

flows.trigger: Canonical entity or review record exists
flows.condition: Role, route, locality and organisation relevance are recorded
flows.action: Assign a segment and the smallest useful set of value modules
flows.example_copy: A module is selected for recipient value, not as recipient evidence
flows.principle: Message positioning is separate from recipient research

flows.trigger: Segment and role state are known
flows.condition: Review status and CTA type are available
flows.action: Assign AQ00, AQ01 or AQ02
flows.example_copy: AQ00 holds; AQ01 routes; AQ02 uses the direct-recipient test
flows.principle: Acquisition track controls cadence; internal calendar does not

flows.condition: Verified facts, value modules, sender and route are available
flows.action: Draft the message and run hook, claim and duplicate-account checks
flows.example_copy: Use reason, recipient value, Silverleaf contribution and one CTA
flows.principle: Hook is optional and must be traceable

flows.condition: Public business route is usable; decision-maker is uncertain; no active duplicate
flows.action: Send one concise routing request
flows.example_copy: Could you point me to the colleague who handles staff welfare or internal communications?
flows.principle: Ask for routing instead of pretending the recipient owns the decision

flows.condition: No reply, referral, refusal, opt-out, bounce, out-of-office response or duplicate account
flows.action: Send one simple check-in and close the track
flows.example_copy: Is there a better colleague for this, or should I close the request?
flows.principle: One follow-up for an uncertain owner
